summary.text:
Global equities advanced, with the S&P 500 rising 1.31% to 7619.38 and the Nasdaq 100 gaining 2.28% to 28374.25, as the VIX dropped 10.12% to 17.49. Attention focused on Nvidia, where the board reportedly prepares to meet and remove CEO Jensen Huang over an executive affair, prompting resignation calls and China export concerns, with shares closing up 2.87% at 173.73.

The US dollar strengthened, lifting the DXY 0.62% to 102.866. The euro fell 1.08% to 1.1101, GBP/USD slipped 1.19% to 1.3281, and USD/JPY gained 1.02% to 159.59. In commodities, Brent crude rose 1.1% to 92.5 and WTI added 0.42% to 86.4, while gold dropped 0.78% to 3998.60.

Markets are watching the Nvidia leadership fallout, tariff concerns after Canada's ambassador warned Trump policies threaten US investment, and buyer discussions regarding Poundland.
